name: chatpush-mcp-server
description: Send WhatsApp, Telegram, SMS and MAX messages, files and bulk mailings via ChatPush
long_description: Official ChatPush extension. Lets Claude send text messages and files through WhatsApp, a personal Telegram account, Telegram bots, SMS, VK/OK and MAX — with channel cascades, scheduling and bulk mailings — check delivery status, look up phone numbers, manage webhooks, rename chat contacts, connect messengers and manage sub-clients. Requires a ChatPush token from https://chatpush.ru.
